issues.message: Source/port at (0.01, 0.01, 0.0) (component=ex) sits on the PEC z_lo plane and drives a tangential E, the component a perfect conductor holds at zero. What happens next DEPENDS ON THE LANE (issue #1075): the distributed lanes (run(devices=...), forward(distributed=True)) apply the PEC face AFTER injection, so the source is discarded and the probes read exactly zero; the single-device lane applies it BEFORE injection, so the source is NOT discarded and instead drives a component the mirror should force to zero, which makes the result numerically inconsistent rather than silent. Use a normal E source at this face, or offset by one cell (1 mm) off the plane.
